bias.label: Leaning down below 3,760-3,770; bouncing off the 3,693 yearly low

event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed index Thu 19 Nov 15:30 SAST, then Fed Hammack 15:50 SAST (Finviz calendar, checked on the earlier run today).

bullets.title: Yearly low at 3,693
bullets.text: Gold fell to about 3,693 in Asia on Thursday, its lowest since September 2025 (Reuters 3,693.13, FXStreet 3,693.50).

bullets.title: Bounce in Europe
bullets.text: FXStreet says gold is up about 0.4% near 3,740 in European trade, around 10:45 SAST (time inferred from the page, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Dollar near 104
bullets.text: The dollar index hit a fresh 19-month high near 104.00, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Hike odds near 90%
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 90% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and about 10% for a half point (Reuters).

bullets.title: Banks stay bearish
bullets.text: Societe Generale sees 3,870-3,900 as resistance and 3,625, then 3,480-3,440, as downside targets.

bullets.title: Oversold but trending
bullets.text: Daily RSI is near 31, so sharp bounces can happen even though the trend is down.

bullets.title: Busy US afternoon
bullets.text: Jobless claims and the Philly Fed index land at 15:30 SAST, with Fed speakers after, so expect fast moves.

buy.title: Buy plan: retest and hold of 3,693-3,700 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,693-3,700, only if the yearly low holds on a retest

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping back to 3,693-3,700 and holding, not slicing through.
A 15M close back above 3,700 after the dip, ideally a higher low.
Take some profit at 3,720 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying now at 3,740, in the middle of the range. Wait for the zone and a hold.
A 1H close under 3,684 means the low failed. Step aside; 3,625-3,650 is next.
Strong jobless claims or Philly Fed data at 15:30 SAST, or hawkish Fed speakers, can break the low fast.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,760-3,770
look: A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,755.
Take some profit at 3,720 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,740 right after a bounce off the low. Wait for the move into 3,760-3,770 and a rejection.
Gold is oversold (RSI near 31), so the bounce can run. A 1H close above 3,802 opens 3,833-3,852.
Jobless claims and Philly Fed at 15:30 SAST can spike price both ways. Do not enter in the minutes before or after.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
